mission_09: Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search (NAS) optimizes neural network architectures for specific hardware targets, balancing accuracy with latency, memory, and energy constraints. Instead of searching for the most accurate model, hardware-aware NAS finds architectures that maximize accuracy while meeting deployment requirements. The search space defines possible layer types, widths, and depths. A hardware profile specifies constraints (max parameters, latency, memory). Each candidate architecture is evaluated for feasibility (does it fit?) and scored using a multi-objective function (accuracy minus latency penalty). The Pareto frontier identifies architectures that are optimal trade-offs between competing objectives. In this mission, you implement hardware profiles with resource constraints, architecture candidates with parameter/latency/memory estimation, feasibility checking, random search over the architecture space, and Pareto frontier computation for multi-objective optimization.
